purpose: Immutable binding of the Wave07 Taaqol-integration slice reports to their introducing commit SHAs. Two-step protocol per REPAIR F: implementation reports (ledger + handoff + closure summary + integrity snapshot + RUN1/RUN2 + DETERMINISM_COMPARE) ship in commits recording IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD; this manifest ships in the next commit and records REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD + REPORT_BINDING_HEAD. This addresses the general audit finding that a file cannot self-contain the SHA of the commit that first introduces it.

IMPLEMENTATION_CONTENT_HEAD.meaning: HEAD at the moment the Wave07 ledger + handoff document content was authored; documented inside HANDOFF.md.

REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD.meaning: The commit that introduced C13_WAVE07_TYPED_LEDGER.json + HANDOFF.md.

EVIDENCE_COMMIT_HEAD.meaning: The commit that introduced RUN1/RUN2 execution artifacts, DETERMINISM_COMPARE, INTEGRITY_SNAPSHOT, CLOSURE_SUMMARY, and the generator script.

REPORT_BINDING_HEAD.meaning: This manifest's own commit SHA — observable by a fresh audit session via `git log --diff-filter=A -- reports/qiyas_hokom_taaqol_canonical_closure_01/BINDING_MANIFEST.json`.

wave06_report_binding_manifest.verdict: PARTIALLY_VERIFIED — see reaudit-02 for the six locally-closeable defects this Wave07 slice remediates.

how_to_verify.step_1: git rev-parse 7bbbf4a → confirms REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD points to the ledger+handoff commit.
how_to_verify.step_2: git rev-parse f748208 → confirms EVIDENCE_COMMIT_HEAD points to the run artifact + generator script commit.
how_to_verify.step_3: git log --diff-filter=A -- reports/qiyas_hokom_taaqol_canonical_closure_01/BINDING_MANIFEST.json → REPORT_BINDING_HEAD is the returned commit (immediate successor of REPORT_COMMIT_HEAD).
how_to_verify.step_4: sha256sum on each bound_artifacts[].path → must match the sha256 field. Any divergence means the report has been mutated post-binding.
how_to_verify.step_5: git rev-parse hokom-canonical-gate-27-closed → verify the historical tag still points to its pre-existing commit (this session did not move it).
how_to_verify.step_6: git status --porcelain=v2 --untracked-files=all → returns zero bytes (T0 gitignore removes the .claude/ ambiguity).
